name: Dire Wolf

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.description: The wolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The wolf has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

description: Dire wolves hunt in coordinated packs far larger and more cunning than their common cousins, and are prized as mounts by giants and hobgoblin warlords alike.
